text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Manchester United and Tottenham at Old Trafford!
It's been a mixed season for United so far, with both highs and a lot of lows for the Red Devils.
They start the day in ninth place, sitting nine points off the top four, and aren't in great form to try and close that gap.
In December, they won just two of their eight matches in all competitions (D1 L5), though both of those wins did come at home.
They started the new year off with a 2-0 win over Wigan Athletic in the FA Cup and will be hoping to build on that to turn their league form around.

As for Spurs, a win here would not only see them complete their first league double over United in the Premier League era after winning the reverse fixture 2-0 in August, but it would also move them into the top four at Arsenal's expense.
After a run of five without a victory in the Premier League, Spurs have lost just one of the following five matches, winning the other four.
They also come into this game on the back of an FA Cup victory, with a late goal seeing them edge past Burnley 1-0 last time out.
Erik ten Hag makes just one change to the side that beat Wigan in the FA Cup on Monday.
Eriksen has recovered from illness to start, replacing McTominay, who drops to the bench.
They're also boosted by the return of three players from injury, with Casemiro, Martinez and Antony among the substitutes.
Ange Postecoglou makes four changes from their late win over Burnley in the FA Cup last weekend.
Romero is fit to start after a hamstring problem, with Van de Ven, Hojbjerg and Werner, who makes his debut for the club after joining on loan from RB Leipzig, also coming in.
Emerson starts on the bench alongside their other new signing, Dragusin.
Dejan Kulusevski is ill, while Ben Davies and Giovanni Lo Celso are both out injured.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Fernandes gets the game under way for United!
United are enjoying all of the possession in the opening minutes and will be looking to impress as Jim Ratcliffe is in the crowd for the first time.
Rashford drives down the left before picking out Wan-Bissaka's underlapping run, but the pass is too heavy.
HOJLUND SCORES! What a start for United! Onana gets rid of it quickly to Garnacho, and he tees up Fernandes for a wonderful pass over the top for Rashford.

He cuts inside from the left but runs into Hojlund before Udogie nicks it off the Englishman, but the interception goes straight to Hojlund, who gets it out of his feet and rifles it into the roof of the net.

events.action: rifles it into the roof of the net

text: 1-0 United!
Dalot plays United into trouble deep in their own half with a sloppy pass to Bentancur, and he slots it into Richarlison.
Evans steps in to stop him from getting a shot away, but Spurs win it back to earn a corner.
United have made a really bright start here as Mainoo sweeps it out to Garnacho on the right.
He chooses to help it onto Dalot on the outside, but his low cross is blocked by Udogie.
CHANCE! Rashford is completely unmarked on the far side of the box as the corner is floated into him, and he meets it first time on the volley.
It has Vicario scrambling across goal for a second, but it was always bouncing wide of the post.
Garnacho is offside for Fernandes' cross so Vicario collects, and he sets Spurs on a quick counter.
Werner carries it down the left before it's worked across-field to Porro, but he snatches at his shot on the edge of the box, and it's comfortable for Onana.
OFF THE LINE! Evans glanced Werner's nodded pass to Richarlison out for a corner, and United are all over the place at the back.
The set-piece comes in, and Bentancur flicks it towards the far post, but Dalot is well-placed to clear it off the line.
Spurs are upping the pressure now and win another corner on the opposite side.
Porro's corner isn't convincingly cleared by Wan-Bissaka, and though Skipp keeps it alive, Johnson is offside when it comes to him.
Hojlund has now scored in consecutive league appearances for the first time since February 2023 for Atalanta, when he netted against Lazio and Lecce in Serie A.
It's a brilliant switch of play from Mainoo out to Rashford on the left, and he knocks it past Porro before pulling it back from the byline.
He has Hojlund and Fernandes waiting in the middle, but Romero sticks out a leg to block it.
RICHARLISON EQUALISES! Spurs win another corner, and Porro floats it into the crowd on the edge of the six-yard box.
Richarlison rises above everyone else to flick it onto the far post, and it bounces in at the far post to bring Spurs level.
Porro's deliveries on corners have been good so far, and he sends United scrambling once more, and no one in red can get close to it.
Spurs are dominating possession now, and United are dropping deeper into their own half.
The Red Devils are staying compact, trying to ride out this wave of pressure.
Werner drives forward down the left, and when he cuts inside, there's wide open space ahead of him.
His eyes light up as he takes it on from range, but he gets it all wrong as it sails high and well wide of the target.
Wan-Bissaka slides in on Johnson, and though he got the ball, he took out the Spurs man with his follow-through.
He gets the first booking of the game, much to United's frustration.
The offside flag goes up against Spurs, and when the whistle goes to signal the decision, Bentancur kicks the ball away.
He's booked for time-wasting.
United are starting to regain their rhythm from earlier, as Fernandes and Rashford link up down the left.
The latter tries to dink a cross into Hojlund, but Porro rushes out to smother it.
Spurs have now scored in each of their last 33 Premier League games, since a 1-0 defeat at Wolves in March last season.
It's the outright-longest scoring run in the club's league history.
SAVE! There's isn't a lot of room for Werner down the left, so it's switched out to the right side once more.
Johnson takes a touch before trying his luck from just inside the box, but it's a comfortable one for Onana.
There are half-hearted shouts from Garnacho and some of the Old Trafford crowd as the youngster goes down in the box.
He had Udogie tight to his back when he went down, but there wasn't a lot in it, and the referee waves him back to his feet.
Fernandes' cross is too high, and once again, Spurs quickly move it from one end of the field to the other.
Porro lifts another good cross in from the right, but nobody is in the middle to reach this one.
Van de Ven wants too long on the ball, and Hojlund picks his pocket before poking it forward for Fernandes.
He can't bring it under control with Bentancur behind him, and the Uruguayan helps it back to Vicario.
OFF THE POST! Rashford whips a cross in from the left, and it's too high for Hojlund in the middle.
Udogie knows Garnacho is somewhere behind him, so tries to head it out, but it smacks back off the post, much to his relief.
RASHFORD SCORES! United are back in the lead! It's been coming in the last few minutes, and the hosts win it back high upfield once more.
It's quickly worked out to the left, and Rashford plays a one-two with Hojlund before drilling a low shot past Vicario and into the far bottom corner.

events.action: drilling a low shot past Vicario

text: 2-1 United!
Hojlund had Romero tight to his back, and all he needs to do is cushion it back into Rashford's path as he shields the defender from the ball.
Spurs are looking to get a quick response with half-time quickly approaching, and Skipp tries to set Richarlison away through the middle.
He can't bring it under control though, and Evans hooks it away.
Garnacho has acres of space to run into down the right again, and he tries to set up Hojlund.
The Dane helps it onto Rashford on the far side instead, and he leaves Porro on the ground as he checks inside, only to run into Romero.
WIDE! United are caught out with a simple big switch out to Werner on the left, and he wrongfoots Dalot as he dummies cutting inside.
He drives into the box, but drags at his shot, sending it wide of the far post.
OFF THE BAR! United are all over the place on another corner as Porro picks out Romero with the delivery this time.
He gets above Garnacho to thump a header on goal, but it's just too high as it smacks the crossbar.
Hojlund tried to prevent Spurs from taking a quick free-kick inside their own half by walking over the ball, and then gets involved in an argument with Romero.
He's booked for time-wasting.
HALF-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 2-1 TOTTENHAM.
United take a 2-1 lead over Spurs into half-time.
The Red Devils couldn't have gotten off to a better start as Hojlund rifled a powerful shot into the roof of the net for his second Premier League goal.

events.action: rifled a powerful shot into the roof of the net

text: At the other end, Richarlison extended his scoring run, rising highest on a corner to glance in the equaliser.
20 minutes later, Rashford restored United's lead, drilling a low shot into the bottom corner.

events.action: drilling a low shot into the bottom corner

text: Udogie also struck his own goalpost with an attempted clearance, before Romero thumped a header against the bar at the other end.
Ten Hag will be fairly pleased with what he's seen so far, at least in an attacking sense.
United have shown a threat going forward, but at the other end, they've looked shaky, especially from corners, which is something he'll want to improve on.

Spurs, meanwhile, will be looking to exploit that further having shown their biggest threat from set-pieces, but Postecoglou will be expecting a big improvement in the second half as they try to get back into this game.
Spurs get us back under way for the second half!

BENTANCUR EQUALISES! What a start to the second half for Spurs! Romero cuts United's midfield wide open with a throughball into Skipp, and he drives through the middle before switching it out to Werner on the left.
He lays it off to Bentancur, who runs at Evans, gets a yard on the defender, and fires a powerful shot past Onana and into the far corner.

events.action: fires a powerful shot past Onana

source.label: assist
source.text: He lays it off to Bentancur

text: Werner could've cut inside and tried to go for goal himself, but instead, he tees up Bentancur and gets an assist on his debut.
Rashford latches onto a loose pass, and instantly turns on his heels to run at Spurs' defence.
He doesn't get far before Romero steps in his path, and the attack fizzles out.
Johnson clips it in from the right, and Dalot is at full stretch to glance it away from Werner, who is hovering on the far side of the box.
The right-back then sets Garnacho on the counter, but he runs it out of play.
SAVE! Spurs have all of the momentum here, and Bentancur threads another good throughball into the middle for Skipp.
He has a crowd in front of him, so he sweeps it out to Richarlison instead, but his low shot is straight at Onana.
Fernandes has his pocket picked, but luckily for him, Hojbjerg's switch out to Skipp is short.
Wan-Bissaka slides it forward for Rashford to chase, but he can't reach it.
Neither team is able to keep hold of the ball at the moment.
Porro's free-kick on the right is thumped out for a corner by Varane, but he doesn't have much luck from that either.
The Spaniard's cross is flicked away by Evans, and Garnacho helps it out of the danger zone.
CHANCE! Spurs' corner count is up to nine, as Evans heads out Porro's latest delivery for another.
The Spaniard clips this one to the far side for Werner, and he hits it on the volley, but it sails over the bar.
With United struggling to get a foothold so far in the second half, Ten Hag is making his first change.
Eriksen is taken off, with McTominay on in his place.
It's a clever flick from Fernandes out to Hojlund on the left, and he surges down the wing before squaring it into the middle.
It looks like Vicario has it covered, but Udogie puts it out for a corner just in front of him.
It comes to nothing for the hosts.
WIDE! Hojlund knocks it through to Wan-Bissaka, and he almost gets a sight of goal before Bentancur takes it off his toe.
His interception rolls straight to McTominay's feet, but he drills his low shot just wide of the far post.
United's second change of the game sees Martinez make his return from a long injury lay-off as he replaces Evans.
Udogie keeps the ball in play, but when he turns to go back into the box, he gets into a tangle with Garnacho, with both players slipping.
Dalot's clearance is poor as he gifts it to Skipp, but the right-back recovers well to cut out the pass to Richarlison.
McTominay nicked the ball off Udogie, and the left-back stayed down holding his ankle.
He needs treatment, and he's quickly back to his feet but moving gingerly.
He's able to carry on.
Porro's corner is only half-cleared by McTominay as far as Skipp on the edge of the box.
He lets it bounce before putting his laces through the half-volley, but McTominay is there again to help it out for another corner.
Johnson looks to have a free run down the right, but Martinez reads it well for United.
He steps in before the cross can go into the box, and picks the winger's pocket to clear the danger for United.
Hojlund's pressure on Bentancur pays off as he forces him into a turnover, and Garnacho tries to pick out the Dane with a throughball.
Spurs crowd him out on the edge of the box though, seeing it back to Vicario.
Wan-Bissaka commits himself to try and intercept a pass, but misses the ball, so it rolls through to Johnson.
Martinez is on the cover, but the winger gets the shot away quickly.
Onana gets behind it and holds onto it.
Richarlison wants a free-kick after losing the ball to Martinez, but United are allowed to carry on, with Garnacho bursting down the right.
He curls an early cross towards the far post which Rashford isn't reaching it, but they win a corner off Porro.
It's another long ball over the top that has United's defence scrambling as Skipp looks for Johnson.
His clever backheel flick looks to set him through on goal until Wan-Bissaka gets back to shield it into Onana.
Werner's Spurs debut comes to an end after 80 minutes as he's replaced by Gil in Postecoglou's first change.
McTominay gets it into Fernandes, and his throughball slides between Spurs' centre-backs as he looks for Rashford.
The Englishman's first touch lets him down though, and it's a comfortable one for Vicario.
Garnacho goes for the big switch out to Rashford on the left once more, and he goes past Johnson before coming up against Porro.
The Spaniard steps across him to stop the run, and United have a free-kick just outside the box.
Spurs' second change is a defensive one.
Dragusin comes on to make his Premier League debut as he replaces Skipp.
Fernandes steps up to take the free-kick on the left and he whips it towards the near post, but it hits Porro in the wall.
McTominay debates keeping it alive on the far side, but instead, accepts a throw-in.
The final roll of the dice for United sees Rashford taken off, with Antony on in his place.
Van de Ven attempts to make a long, slow walk off the pitch, but the referee shepherds him off at the nearest point.
Emerson is on for the last few minutes.
The board goes up to show there will be a minimum of five added minutes as United push forward once more.
Antony swings a cross in from the right, but he can't pick out a red shirt in a very crowded box.
It's a great tackle from Wan-Bissaka to stop Johnson on the halfway line, and United counter again, only for it to fizzle out in the final third.
Fernandes is trying to pick out Hojlund, but it's an easy clearance for Emerson on the penalty spot.
WHAT A CHANCE! Was that the opportunity for United to win it? It's a wonderful cross from Garnacho on the left, and McTominay is unmarked as he rises to meet it.
He thumps a header on goal, but it sails just over the crossbar.
FULL-TIME: MANCHESTER UNITED 2-2 TOTTENHAM.
Spurs come from behind twice to earn a 2-2 draw with United.
The hosts got off to a perfect start as Hojlund rifled them in front in just under three minutes, though they were pegged back shortly after when Richarlison glanced in a corner to equalise.

Rashford put the Red Devils back in front just before half-time with a composed finish while Udogie hit his own post with an attempted clearance and Romero thumped a header against the bar at the other end.
Spurs came out flying for the second half, scoring in under a minute as Bentancur drilled a powerful shot across goal to get them back on level terms again.
McTominay almost snatched a win in the dying seconds for United, only to head just over the crossbar.
It's a point that lifts United up to seventh, and next up for them is an FA Cup tie against either Newport County or Eastleigh in two weeks' time.
Spurs miss the chance to move into the top four but are now level on points with Arsenal above them.
They host Manchester City in the fourth round of the FA Cup next time out.
That's all for today, goodbye!
